abstract: Thirty Saudi patients with pure testicular seminoma were treated at King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Centre in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, between January 1977 and June 1983. Disease characteristics in Saudi Arabia including clinical findings, response to therapy, and prognosis are described and compared to those in other populations reported in the literature. Symptom durations were 3 to 42 months. Many of the patients presented with an extensive tumor burden and a poor performance status. There was a higher incidence of anaplastic seminoma and of cryptorchidism than in other series and a relatively high incidence of elevated betahuman chorionic gonadotropin (B-HCG). Patients initially underwent funiculo-orchiectomy. Twenty-two patients received radiation therapy and four received chemotherapy. Patients with limited disease responded well to orchiectomy and radiation therapy. However, those with extensive tumor burden had an unsatisfactory response to radiation therapy. Preradiation chemotherapy is recommended for patients with massive retroperitoneal metastases, nodal disease above the diaphragm, or extranodal disease and patients with minimal or moderate sized retroperitoneal nodal disease associated with an elevated B-HCG.
abstract_ja: サウジアラビアのリヤドにあるキング・ファイサル専門病院研究センターで、1977年1月から1983年6月の間に治療された純粋型精巣セミノーマの患者30例を報告する。臨床所見、治療反応、予後を記述し、他の文献の集団と比較する。症状持続期間は3〜42か月であった。多くの患者は広範な腫瘍量と不良な全身状態で受診した。他の報告と比べ、未分化型セミノーマと停留精巣の頻度が高く、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値も比較的多く認められた。患者は当初、精索精巣摘除術を受けた。22例が放射線療法を、4例が化学療法を受けた。限局病変の患者は精巣摘除と放射線療法によく反応した。しかし、腫瘍量が多い患者では放射線療法への反応が不十分であった。大量の後腹膜転移、横隔膜より上のリンパ節病変、節外病変、またはhCG上昇を伴う小〜中等度の後腹膜リンパ節病変を有する患者には、放射線療法前の化学療法を推奨する。
